QUOTE: `library/error.c` is not hand-written. The index shows it is generated by `scripts/generate_errors.pl`: `library/CMakeLists.txt:134` runs a custom command that calls `generate_errors.pl` with `include/mbedtls` and `scripts/data_files`, and writes `error.c` into the build directory. The command depends on `error_headers` and `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`.
